records.name: Sandoz
records.description:
If you’re craving authentic North Indian flavors served in a lively and welcoming setting, Sandoz Restaurant is a place that never disappoints. Located in the heart of Delhi, this popular dining spot has built a strong reputation for its rich taste, generous portions, and vibrant atmosphere—making it a favorite among families, friends, and food lovers.

The moment you step into Sandoz, you’re greeted with a warm and energetic vibe. The interiors are simple yet inviting, designed to make guests feel comfortable and relaxed. It’s not about over-the-top luxury here—it’s about good food, good company, and a space where everyone feels at home.

Sandoz is especially known for its delicious North Indian cuisine. From buttery curries to smoky tandoori dishes, every item on the menu is prepared with authentic spices and traditional techniques. The aroma itself is enough to get your appetite going, and the flavors ensure you leave satisfied every time.

Whether you’re planning a casual lunch, a family dinner, or a small celebration, Sandoz offers the perfect setting. The seating arrangement is spacious enough for groups, making it ideal for gatherings, birthday parties, and get-togethers.

🌟 Key Features:

  • Authentic North Indian and Mughlai cuisine
  • Comfortable and family-friendly ambiance
  • Ideal for casual dining and group gatherings
  • Generous portion sizes and value for money
  • Quick service and friendly staff
  • Centrally located with easy accessibility
  • Suitable for small celebrations and parties

One of the biggest highlights of Sandoz is its consistency. Regular visitors often return for their favorite dishes, knowing they’ll get the same great taste every time. From rich gravies like butter chicken and dal makhani to freshly baked naan and kebabs, every dish reflects quality and tradition.

The service is fast and attentive, ensuring that guests don’t have to wait long even during busy hours. The staff is polite and helpful, always ready to suggest popular dishes or customize orders based on preferences.

Another advantage of Sandoz is its location. Being in a central area, it’s easily accessible for people coming from different parts of the city, making it a convenient choice for meet-ups and dining plans.

What truly makes Sandoz special is its simplicity and focus on food. It doesn’t try to be overly fancy—it focuses on delivering a satisfying dining experience that feels genuine and enjoyable.

Whether you’re a food lover looking for authentic flavors or someone planning a relaxed outing with friends and family, Sandoz Restaurant is a reliable choice. With its delicious food, welcoming vibe, and consistent quality, it continues to be a go-to spot for memorable meals in Delhi.

event_type.name: Social
event_type.description: The term "social" refers to the relationships and interactions within society. It involves individual and collective actions and activities that bring people together and foster communication. Social activities such as spending time with friends, engaging in community service, and participating in public forums are essential for making positive contributions to society.

event_type.name: Meetings
event_type.description: Meetings are gatherings where people come together to discuss and exchange ideas or information for a specific purpose. They can vary in nature, such as work-related meetings, family discussions, or social gatherings. The main objective of meetings is to make decisions on issues, share information, solve problems, or deliberate on a particular plan.

event_type.name: Weddings
event_type.description: Weddings mark the beginning of a lifelong relationship, where two individuals come together to unite in marriage. It is a significant and joyous occasion, often celebrated with traditional rituals, religious ceremonies, and cultural festivities. On the wedding day, the bride and groom embark on this new chapter of their lives surrounded by their families and friends. Various customs, such as engagement, haldi, mehendi, and other traditions, make the wedding ceremony even more special and memorable

event_type.name: Birthday Parties

On this special day, family and friends gather to make the person feel special and celebrate together. Birthday parties typically include activities like cutting a cake, gift exchanges, playing games, and enjoying music. event_type.name: Themed Parties
event_type.description: A themed party is a celebration organized around a specific theme or concept. The decorations, attire, and activities are planned based on the chosen theme, such as 80s, Bollywood, Halloween, or a fun carnival theme. Guests typically dress according to the theme, and the event's decor and food are aligned with it. Themed parties are informal and creative, offering guests a unique and immersive experience.

event_type.name: New Year Party

It is celebrated with friends, family, and colleagues, filled with joy, excitement, and enthusiasm. event_type.name: Corporate Parties

cuisine_details.name: American Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: American cuisine is diverse and influenced by various cultures, including Native American, European, African, and Asian. It features a wide range of dishes, from classic comfort foods like burgers, fried chicken, and macaroni and cheese to regional specialties such as Southern BBQ, New England clam chowder, and Southwestern tacos. American cuisine often highlights convenience, bold flavors, and an emphasis on grilling and frying.

cuisine_details.name: Chinese Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Chinese cuisine is one of the oldest and most diverse in the world, known for its variety of flavors, ingredients, and cooking techniques. It emphasizes balance in taste, texture, and color, with a focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients. Key elements include rice, noodles, vegetables, and meats like pork, chicken, beef, and seafood. Chinese cuisine is also recognized for its use of soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and a range of spices like five-spice powder and chili.

cuisine_details.name: Continental Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Continental cuisine refers to the traditional cooking styles and dishes of European countries, especially those from Western and Central Europe. It includes a variety of ingredients, cooking techniques, and flavors that focus on fresh, high-quality products. The cuisine emphasizes a balance of flavors, with a preference for lighter, more refined meals compared to some other global cuisines.

cuisine_details.name: Indian Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Indian cuisine is incredibly diverse, reflecting the country’s rich cultural, geographical, and historical diversity. It is known for its bold flavors, vibrant spices, and a variety of ingredients, with a focus on balance between sweet, sour, salty, and spicy elements. Indian meals often feature rice, bread (like roti or naan), lentils, vegetables, and meats such as chicken, lamb, and fish, although vegetarianism is common, particularly in regions like Gujarat and Rajasthan.

cuisine_details.name: Indian Singaporean Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Indian Singaporean cuisine is a fusion of traditional Indian flavors with local Singaporean influences, creating a unique and vibrant culinary experience. It reflects Singapore’s multicultural society, where Indian culinary traditions blend with Chinese, Malay, and other Southeast Asian influences.

cuisine_details.name: Mughlai Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Mughlai cuisine is a rich and flavorful culinary tradition that originated in the royal kitchens of the Mughal Empire, which ruled over much of South Asia from the 16th to the 19th centuries. Known for its use of aromatic spices, rich gravies, and tender meats, Mughlai cuisine combines elements of Persian, Central Asian, and Indian culinary traditions. It features complex flavors, with a balance of spicy, sour, and sweet notes.

cuisine_details.name: Italian
cuisine_details.description: Italian cuisine is a globally loved culinary tradition known for its fresh ingredients, rich flavors, and comforting dishes. It features favorites like pasta, pizza, risotto, lasagna, and classic desserts such as tiramisu. Perfect for weddings and events, Italian cuisine offers a delightful and elegant dining experience for guests.

cuisine_details.name: Street Food
cuisine_details.description: Street food cuisine brings the vibrant flavors of local markets and roadside favorites to your event. It features popular delights like chaat, golgappa, pav bhaji, momos, rolls, and regional snacks prepared live. Ideal for weddings, parties, and festive gatherings, street food counters create an interactive, fun, and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Fast Food
cuisine_details.description: Fast food cuisine offers quick, delicious, and crowd-pleasing dishes loved by guests of all ages. It includes popular items like burgers, pizzas, sandwiches, fries, wraps, and fried snacks. Ideal for parties, corporate events, and casual gatherings, fast food counters provide convenient service and a fun, energetic dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Pure Vegetarian
cuisine_details.description: Pure Vegetarian cuisine features a wide variety of dishes prepared entirely without meat, poultry, or seafood. It includes flavorful curries, lentils, fresh vegetables, breads, rice preparations, and delightful desserts. Ideal for weddings, religious events, and social gatherings, pure vegetarian menus offer a wholesome, diverse, and satisfying dining experience for all guests.

cuisine_details.name: Vegan
cuisine_details.description: Vegan cuisine is a plant-based culinary style prepared without any animal products, including dairy, eggs, or honey. It features fresh vegetables, grains, legumes, nuts, and innovative dairy-free alternatives. Ideal for modern weddings and health-conscious events, vegan menus offer a nutritious, sustainable, and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: BBQ & Gril
cuisine_details.description: BBQ & Grill cuisine features smoky, flame-cooked dishes prepared over open grills or charcoal. It includes grilled vegetables, paneer, kebabs, skewers, seafood, and marinated specialties served hot and fresh. Ideal for outdoor events, weddings, and cocktail parties, BBQ and grill counters create an interactive and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Multi-Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Multi-cuisine offers a diverse selection of dishes from different regional and international culinary traditions in one menu. It includes Indian, Continental, Asian, and other global specialties to suit varied tastes. Ideal for weddings and large events, multi-cuisine catering ensures variety, flexibility, and a satisfying dining experience for all guests.

terms_conditions_details.name: Terms & Conditions
terms_conditions_details.description: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation upon receipt of advance payment. A signed agreement or written confirmation is required to secure the event date. Payment schedules must be followed as agreed. Cancellation or rescheduling requests may be subject to applicable charges as per venue policy. The management reserves the right to enforce event timing, sound regulations, and safety guidelines in compliance with local laws. Any damage to property during the event will be chargeable to the client. The venue reserves the right to refuse service in case of non-compliance with policies.

terms_conditions_details.name: Booking & Event Terms
terms_conditions_details.description: Bookings are confirmed only upon receipt of the agreed advance amount and written confirmation from management. Remaining payments must be cleared as per the agreed schedule prior to the event. Cancellation, postponement, or date changes will be governed by the venue’s cancellation policy and may involve retention of advance payments. Event timing, sound limits, alcohol service, and guest conduct must comply with venue rules and applicable government regulations. Outside vendors may require prior approval. Clients are responsible for any loss or damage to venue property during the event. Management reserves the right to modify policies without prior notice and to decline services in case of policy violations.

terms_conditions_details.name: Booking is confirmed only after advance payment.
terms_conditions_details.description: A booking will be considered confirmed only after receiving the agreed advance payment. Verbal commitments or tentative holds do not guarantee reservation. The advance secures the date and venue exclusively for the client, preventing double bookings and ensuring proper event planning and resource allocation.

terms_conditions_details.name: Advance amount is non-refundable.
terms_conditions_details.description: The advance payment made at the time of booking is strictly non-refundable. This policy applies in case of cancellation or postponement by the client. The advance covers administrative costs, date blocking, and preliminary arrangements made for the event.

terms_conditions_details.name: Remaining balance must be paid before event date.
terms_conditions_details.description: The remaining balance amount must be cleared before the scheduled event date, as per agreed timelines. Failure to complete payment may result in service interruption or cancellation. Timely payment ensures smooth coordination, vendor confirmation, and uninterrupted event execution.

terms_conditions_details.name: Prices are subject to change without prior notice.
terms_conditions_details.description: All quoted prices are subject to revision based on market conditions, government regulations, or cost fluctuations. While confirmed bookings remain secure, additional services or modifications requested later may be charged at updated rates.

terms_conditions_details.name: Guest count must be informed 7 days prior to event.
terms_conditions_details.description: Final guest count must be communicated at least seven days before the event date. This ensures proper seating, catering preparation, staffing, and overall arrangements. Changes after the deadline may incur additional charges.

terms_conditions_details.name: Minimum guarantee pax required.
terms_conditions_details.description: A minimum guaranteed number of guests (pax) is required as per the agreement. Billing will be based on the guaranteed count, even if actual attendance is lower. This helps the venue plan catering, staffing, and service resources efficiently.

terms_conditions_details.name: Taxes will be charged as applicable.
terms_conditions_details.description: All applicable government taxes and service charges will be added to the final invoice as per prevailing laws. Tax rates are subject to change according to government regulations and will be charged accordingly.

terms_conditions_details.name: Overtime charges applicable beyond agreed hours.
terms_conditions_details.description: Events extending beyond the agreed booking duration will incur additional overtime charges. These charges cover staff, utilities, security, and operational costs. Overtime rates will be applied as per the venue’s standard pricing policy.

terms_conditions_details.name: Date change subject to availability.
terms_conditions_details.description: Requests for changing the event date are subject to venue availability. Approval is not guaranteed and may involve additional charges. Advance payments may be adjusted to the new date as per venue policies.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cancellation before 30 days – partial refund.
terms_conditions_details.description: Cancellations requested more than 30 days prior to the event date are eligible for a partial refund of the total booking amount. This deduction accounts for administrative overhead and the opportunity cost of holding the date. The exact percentage of the refund will be determined based on the specific event package.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cancellation within 15 days – no refund.
terms_conditions_details.description: Any cancellation made within 15 days of the scheduled event is strictly non-refundable. At this stage, resources have been fully committed, staff scheduled, and the venue has lost the ability to rebook the date. This policy ensures the venue is protected against late-stage revenue loss and operational expenses.

terms_conditions_details.name: Security deposit mandatory.
terms_conditions_details.description: A security deposit is a mandatory requirement for all event bookings to cover unforeseen contingencies. This deposit is held separately from the event fee and acts as a financial guarantee. It must be paid in full along with the final balance to ensure the booking remains valid and active.

terms_conditions_details.name: Leftover food policy as per venue rules.
terms_conditions_details.description: The handling and removal of leftover food are strictly governed by venue health and safety regulations. Due to liability and food safety concerns regarding temperature control, taking leftover food off-site may be restricted or require a signed waiver. Please consult with the floor manager for the specific event-day protocol.

terms_conditions_details.name: Any damage caused by guests chargeable.
terms_conditions_details.description: The client is financially responsible for any damage to the venue’s structure, furniture, or equipment caused by the negligence or misconduct of their guests. An assessment of repairs will be conducted post-event, and the costs will be recovered from the security deposit or billed directly to the client.

terms_conditions_details.name: Guests must follow local authority rules.
terms_conditions_details.description: All event attendees are required to adhere to the regulations set forth by the municipal corporation and local police. This includes adherence to parking norms, public smoking bans, and health and safety protocols. Non-compliance with these public orders may lead to penalties being levied against the event host.

terms_conditions_details.name: Loud music beyond permitted hours not allowed.
terms_conditions_details.description: To comply with local noise pollution regulations and community guidelines, all amplified music must cease by the legally mandated time. The venue reserves the right to disconnect power to sound systems if volume limits or timing restrictions are ignored. It is the client's responsibility to manage their DJ’s performance.

terms_conditions_details.name: Illegal activities strictly prohibited.
terms_conditions_details.description: The premises must be used exclusively for lawful purposes. Any form of gambling, substance abuse, or other activities prohibited by law will result in immediate event termination and notification to the authorities. The client assumes full legal responsibility for any unlawful conduct occurring during their booked time slot.

terms_conditions_details.name: Venue not responsible for personal belongings.
terms_conditions_details.description: The venue management and staff are not liable for the loss, theft, or damage of any personal items, jewelry, or electronics brought onto the premises by guests or vendors. We strongly recommend that clients arrange for their own security or storage for valuables, as the venue does not provide locker facilities.

terms_conditions_details.name: Smoking only in designated areas.
terms_conditions_details.description: To maintain a smoke-free environment and ensure the comfort of all attendees, smoking is strictly prohibited inside the main halls, dining areas, and restrooms. Guests wishing to smoke must use the specifically marked outdoor zones. This policy helps prevent fire hazards and ensures compliance with public health and safety regulations.

package_details.name: Pre-Wedding Delight Package
package_details.description: Add flavor to your pre-wedding celebrations with the Pre-Wedding Delight Package, perfect for functions like mehendi or haldi. This package offers a delicious spread including creamy Butter Chicken, fragrant Chicken Biryani, and soft Butter Naan. Guests are welcomed with a light Sweet Corn Soup and can enjoy the rich sweetness of Gulab Jamun for dessert. Carefully curated for taste and convenience, it provides a satisfying experience for all guests. Whether it’s a lively gathering or a close-knit celebration, this package ensures your pre-wedding moments are filled with great food and joyful memories.

package_details.name: Romantic Candle Light Dinner Package
package_details.suitable_for: Couples, Anniversary Celebrations, Birthday Parties, Groups of 2–4, Private Dining Experience
package_details.description: Enjoy a premium romantic dining experience with our specially curated Candle Light Dinner Package. This package includes delicious multi-cuisine dishes, elegant table decoration, complimentary dessert, and a cozy ambiance perfect for special occasions like anniversaries, birthdays, proposals, and private celebrations. Designed to create unforgettable memories with exceptional hospitality and taste.

venue_configuration.name: Cluster Style
venue_configuration.description: Cluster style is a seating arrangement typically used in meeting or event spaces, where chairs or tables are grouped together in small clusters or circles. This setup encourages interaction, collaboration, and discussion among participants, making it ideal for brainstorming sessions, team meetings, or group activities. It offers a more informal and flexible alternative to traditional rows of seating.

venue_configuration.name: Banquet Hall
venue_configuration.description: A banquet hall is a large, spacious venue typically used for hosting events such as weddings, parties, conferences, or formal gatherings. It is designed to accommodate a significant number of guests and is often equipped with tables, chairs, and catering facilities. Banquet halls offer a versatile setting for various social and professional events.

venue_configuration.name: Long Style
venue_configuration.description: The long style, often referred to as "theater style" or "row seating," is a seating arrangement where chairs are placed in rows, all facing a central stage or presentation area. This setup is commonly used for events like lectures, presentations, or performances where the primary focus is on the speaker or stage. It allows for a large number of attendees to be seated in a compact space, maximizing the room's capacity.

venue_configuration.name: Open
venue_configuration.description: The "open" style refers to a flexible, unstructured seating arrangement where there are no fixed configurations, allowing participants to sit freely in the space. It is commonly used for casual or interactive events, workshops, or networking sessions where movement, collaboration, and informal conversations are encouraged. This style fosters a relaxed and dynamic environment, with no assigned seating or rigid structure.

cuisine_details.description: North Indian cuisine is known for its rich flavors, aromatic spices, and traditional cooking techniques. It features popular dishes like butter chicken, paneer tikka, dal makhani, kebabs, and a variety of breads such as naan and tandoori roti. Perfect for weddings, parties, and banquets, North Indian cuisine offers a hearty and satisfying dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Hyderabadi
cuisine_details.description: Hyderabadi cuisine is a royal culinary tradition known for its rich spices, aromatic flavors, and slow-cooked delicacies. Famous for Hyderabadi biryani, haleem, kebabs, and flavorful curries, it blends Mughlai and South Indian influences. Perfect for weddings and grand celebrations, Hyderabadi cuisine offers a luxurious and unforgettable dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Thai
cuisine_details.description: Thai cuisine is a vibrant culinary style known for its perfect balance of sweet, sour, spicy, and salty flavors. It features popular dishes like Pad Thai, green curry, red curry, Tom Yum soup, and fresh spring rolls. Ideal for weddings and events, Thai cuisine offers a refreshing and exotic dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Italian
cuisine_details.description: Italian cuisine is a globally loved culinary tradition known for its fresh ingredients, rich flavors, and comforting dishes. It features favorites like pasta, pizza, risotto, lasagna, and classic desserts such as tiramisu. Perfect for weddings and events, Italian cuisine offers a delightful and elegant dining experience for guests.

cuisine_details.name: Fusion
cuisine_details.description: Fusion cuisine is a creative culinary style that blends flavors, ingredients, and cooking techniques from different cultures. It combines traditional recipes with modern twists, offering innovative dishes and unique presentations. Ideal for weddings and premium events, fusion cuisine delivers a diverse, exciting, and memorable dining experience for guests.

cuisine_details.name: Street Food
cuisine_details.description: Street food cuisine brings the vibrant flavors of local markets and roadside favorites to your event. It features popular delights like chaat, golgappa, pav bhaji, momos, rolls, and regional snacks prepared live. Ideal for weddings, parties, and festive gatherings, street food counters create an interactive, fun, and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Fast Food
cuisine_details.description: Fast food cuisine offers quick, delicious, and crowd-pleasing dishes loved by guests of all ages. It includes popular items like burgers, pizzas, sandwiches, fries, wraps, and fried snacks. Ideal for parties, corporate events, and casual gatherings, fast food counters provide convenient service and a fun, energetic dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Vegan
cuisine_details.description: Vegan cuisine is a plant-based culinary style prepared without any animal products, including dairy, eggs, or honey. It features fresh vegetables, grains, legumes, nuts, and innovative dairy-free alternatives. Ideal for modern weddings and health-conscious events, vegan menus offer a nutritious, sustainable, and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: BBQ & Gril
cuisine_details.description: BBQ & Grill cuisine features smoky, flame-cooked dishes prepared over open grills or charcoal. It includes grilled vegetables, paneer, kebabs, skewers, seafood, and marinated specialties served hot and fresh. Ideal for outdoor events, weddings, and cocktail parties, BBQ and grill counters create an interactive and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Multi-Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Multi-cuisine offers a diverse selection of dishes from different regional and international culinary traditions in one menu. It includes Indian, Continental, Asian, and other global specialties to suit varied tastes. Ideal for weddings and large events, multi-cuisine catering ensures variety, flexibility, and a satisfying dining experience for all guests.

terms_conditions_details.name: Terms & Conditions
terms_conditions_details.description: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation upon receipt of advance payment. A signed agreement or written confirmation is required to secure the event date. Payment schedules must be followed as agreed. Cancellation or rescheduling requests may be subject to applicable charges as per venue policy. The management reserves the right to enforce event timing, sound regulations, and safety guidelines in compliance with local laws. Any damage to property during the event will be chargeable to the client. The venue reserves the right to refuse service in case of non-compliance with policies.

terms_conditions_details.name: Booking & Event Terms
terms_conditions_details.description: Bookings are confirmed only upon receipt of the agreed advance amount and written confirmation from management. Remaining payments must be cleared as per the agreed schedule prior to the event. Cancellation, postponement, or date changes will be governed by the venue’s cancellation policy and may involve retention of advance payments. Event timing, sound limits, alcohol service, and guest conduct must comply with venue rules and applicable government regulations. Outside vendors may require prior approval. Clients are responsible for any loss or damage to venue property during the event. Management reserves the right to modify policies without prior notice and to decline services in case of policy violations.

terms_conditions_details.name: Booking is confirmed only after advance payment.
terms_conditions_details.description: A booking will be considered confirmed only after receiving the agreed advance payment. Verbal commitments or tentative holds do not guarantee reservation. The advance secures the date and venue exclusively for the client, preventing double bookings and ensuring proper event planning and resource allocation.

terms_conditions_details.name: Advance amount is non-refundable.
terms_conditions_details.description: The advance payment made at the time of booking is strictly non-refundable. This policy applies in case of cancellation or postponement by the client. The advance covers administrative costs, date blocking, and preliminary arrangements made for the event.

terms_conditions_details.name: Remaining balance must be paid before event date.
terms_conditions_details.description: The remaining balance amount must be cleared before the scheduled event date, as per agreed timelines. Failure to complete payment may result in service interruption or cancellation. Timely payment ensures smooth coordination, vendor confirmation, and uninterrupted event execution.

terms_conditions_details.name: Prices are subject to change without prior notice.
terms_conditions_details.description: All quoted prices are subject to revision based on market conditions, government regulations, or cost fluctuations. While confirmed bookings remain secure, additional services or modifications requested later may be charged at updated rates.

terms_conditions_details.name: Guest count must be informed 7 days prior to event.
terms_conditions_details.description: Final guest count must be communicated at least seven days before the event date. This ensures proper seating, catering preparation, staffing, and overall arrangements. Changes after the deadline may incur additional charges.

terms_conditions_details.name: Minimum guarantee pax required.
terms_conditions_details.description: A minimum guaranteed number of guests (pax) is required as per the agreement. Billing will be based on the guaranteed count, even if actual attendance is lower. This helps the venue plan catering, staffing, and service resources efficiently.

terms_conditions_details.name: Taxes will be charged as applicable.
terms_conditions_details.description: All applicable government taxes and service charges will be added to the final invoice as per prevailing laws. Tax rates are subject to change according to government regulations and will be charged accordingly.

terms_conditions_details.name: Overtime charges applicable beyond agreed hours.
terms_conditions_details.description: Events extending beyond the agreed booking duration will incur additional overtime charges. These charges cover staff, utilities, security, and operational costs. Overtime rates will be applied as per the venue’s standard pricing policy.

terms_conditions_details.name: Date change subject to availability.
terms_conditions_details.description: Requests for changing the event date are subject to venue availability. Approval is not guaranteed and may involve additional charges. Advance payments may be adjusted to the new date as per venue policies.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cancellation before 30 days – partial refund.
terms_conditions_details.description: Cancellations requested more than 30 days prior to the event date are eligible for a partial refund of the total booking amount. This deduction accounts for administrative overhead and the opportunity cost of holding the date. The exact percentage of the refund will be determined based on the specific event package.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cancellation within 15 days – no refund.
terms_conditions_details.description: Any cancellation made within 15 days of the scheduled event is strictly non-refundable. At this stage, resources have been fully committed, staff scheduled, and the venue has lost the ability to rebook the date. This policy ensures the venue is protected against late-stage revenue loss and operational expenses.

terms_conditions_details.name: Security deposit mandatory.
terms_conditions_details.description: A security deposit is a mandatory requirement for all event bookings to cover unforeseen contingencies. This deposit is held separately from the event fee and acts as a financial guarantee. It must be paid in full along with the final balance to ensure the booking remains valid and active.

terms_conditions_details.name: Damage charges will be deducted from deposit.
terms_conditions_details.description: In the event of property damage, equipment breakage, or excessive cleaning requirements, the necessary repair costs will be deducted from the security deposit. If damages exceed the deposit amount, the client remains liable for the additional balance. A post-event inspection will determine the final deduction amount.

terms_conditions_details.name: Corkage charges applicable.
terms_conditions_details.description: If the venue allows clients to bring their own beverages, a standard corkage fee will be applied per bottle. This fee covers the cost of glassware, ice, garnishes, and professional bartending services provided by the venue staff. All outside beverages must be declared and settled within the final billing.

terms_conditions_details.name: Outside decorator allowed with permission.
terms_conditions_details.description: While we offer in-house services, clients may engage an external decorator provided they obtain prior written consent from the venue management. This ensures that the chosen vendor aligns with our safety standards and operational protocols. A nominal gate fee or security deposit may be required for outside vendors.

terms_conditions_details.name: Decoration setup time restricted.
terms_conditions_details.description: To ensure smooth venue operations and back-to-back event coordination, decoration activities are limited to specific time slots. All setup and dismantling must be completed within these designated hours. Any extensions beyond the allotted time will be subject to additional hourly rental charges and management availability.

terms_conditions_details.name: LED wall usage subject to extra cost.
terms_conditions_details.description: Integration of LED walls involves significant power consumption and technical coordination with the venue’s infrastructure. Consequently, a supplemental utility fee is applied for the installation and operation of these displays. This charge covers the additional electrical load and any necessary technical supervision provided by the venue staff.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cleanliness to be maintained by decorator.
terms_conditions_details.description: The decorator is responsible for removing all scrap materials, packing boxes, and floral waste immediately after the setup and dismantling process. The venue must be left in its original condition. Failure to clear debris or maintain basic cleanliness will result in professional cleaning charges being billed to the client’s account.

terms_conditions_details.name: Venue reserves right to deny entry to unruly guests.
terms_conditions_details.description: To maintain a safe and professional environment, the management reserves the absolute right to refuse entry or evict any individual displaying aggressive, intoxicated, or disorderly behavior. This action is taken at the venue's discretion to protect the well-being of other guests, staff, and the property itself.

terms_conditions_details.name: Fire safety rules mandatory.
terms_conditions_details.description: Compliance with all fire safety protocols, including keeping emergency exits clear and adhering to maximum occupancy limits, is mandatory. The use of open flames, lamps, or candles must be pre-approved and placed in secure holders. Any violation of fire safety standards will result in an immediate halt of setup.

terms_conditions_details.name: No hazardous materials allowed.
terms_conditions_details.description: Items classified as hazardous, including explosives, flammable chemicals, pressurized gases, or corrosive substances, are strictly forbidden inside the venue. This policy is in place to prevent accidents and ensure the safety of all occupants. Any vendor bringing specialized equipment must receive prior clearance from the venue manager.

terms_conditions_details.name: Security staff instructions must be followed.
terms_conditions_details.description: For the safety and orderly flow of the event, all guests must comply with the directions provided by the venue’s security personnel. Our staff is authorized to manage crowd control, parking, and access to restricted areas. Failure to cooperate with security may lead to removal from the premises.

terms_conditions_details.name: Any damage caused by guests chargeable.
terms_conditions_details.description: The client is financially responsible for any damage to the venue’s structure, furniture, or equipment caused by the negligence or misconduct of their guests. An assessment of repairs will be conducted post-event, and the costs will be recovered from the security deposit or billed directly to the client.

terms_conditions_details.name: Guests must follow local authority rules.
terms_conditions_details.description: All event attendees are required to adhere to the regulations set forth by the municipal corporation and local police. This includes adherence to parking norms, public smoking bans, and health and safety protocols. Non-compliance with these public orders may lead to penalties being levied against the event host.

terms_conditions_details.name: Loud music beyond permitted hours not allowed.
terms_conditions_details.description: To comply with local noise pollution regulations and community guidelines, all amplified music must cease by the legally mandated time. The venue reserves the right to disconnect power to sound systems if volume limits or timing restrictions are ignored. It is the client's responsibility to manage their DJ’s performance.

terms_conditions_details.name: Venue not responsible for personal belongings.
terms_conditions_details.description: The venue management and staff are not liable for the loss, theft, or damage of any personal items, jewelry, or electronics brought onto the premises by guests or vendors. We strongly recommend that clients arrange for their own security or storage for valuables, as the venue does not provide locker facilities.

terms_conditions_details.name: Smoking only in designated areas.
terms_conditions_details.description: To maintain a smoke-free environment and ensure the comfort of all attendees, smoking is strictly prohibited inside the main halls, dining areas, and restrooms. Guests wishing to smoke must use the specifically marked outdoor zones. This policy helps prevent fire hazards and ensures compliance with public health and safety regulations.

package_details.name: Corporate Cocktail Evening Package
package_details.description: The Corporate Cocktail Evening Package is crafted for relaxed and engaging corporate gatherings. It is perfect for team celebrations, networking events, and informal business meetups. Featuring a wide range of appetizers, finger foods, and live grill options, this package ensures a lively dining experience. The inclusion of mocktails adds a refreshing touch, enhancing the overall vibe of the event. Designed to encourage interaction and bonding, this package offers a stylish yet comfortable setup. Whether you are celebrating milestones or hosting clients, it creates the perfect atmosphere for unwinding and building stronger professional relationships.

venue_configuration.name: Cluster Style
venue_configuration.description: Cluster style is a seating arrangement typically used in meeting or event spaces, where chairs or tables are grouped together in small clusters or circles. This setup encourages interaction, collaboration, and discussion among participants, making it ideal for brainstorming sessions, team meetings, or group activities. It offers a more informal and flexible alternative to traditional rows of seating.

venue_configuration.name: Banquet Hall
venue_configuration.description: A banquet hall is a large, spacious venue typically used for hosting events such as weddings, parties, conferences, or formal gatherings. It is designed to accommodate a significant number of guests and is often equipped with tables, chairs, and catering facilities. Banquet halls offer a versatile setting for various social and professional events.

venue_configuration.name: Long Style
venue_configuration.description: The long style, often referred to as "theater style" or "row seating," is a seating arrangement where chairs are placed in rows, all facing a central stage or presentation area. This setup is commonly used for events like lectures, presentations, or performances where the primary focus is on the speaker or stage. It allows for a large number of attendees to be seated in a compact space, maximizing the room's capacity.

venue_configuration.name: Open
venue_configuration.description: The "open" style refers to a flexible, unstructured seating arrangement where there are no fixed configurations, allowing participants to sit freely in the space. It is commonly used for casual or interactive events, workshops, or networking sessions where movement, collaboration, and informal conversations are encouraged. This style fosters a relaxed and dynamic environment, with no assigned seating or rigid structure.

venue_configuration.name: Banquet Style
venue_configuration.description: Banquet style is a seating arrangement where round tables are placed throughout the room, typically with guests seated around them. This setup is commonly used for events such as weddings, formal dinners, or award ceremonies. Banquet style encourages social interaction among guests while providing space for dining. The tables are often set with linens, chairs, and sometimes a centerpiece, creating a more relaxed and communal atmosphere for dining and conversation.

venue_configuration.name: U Shape Style
venue_configuration.description: The U-shape style is a seating arrangement where tables are arranged in a U-shape, with an open area in the center. The participants sit around the three sides of the "U," allowing them to face each other while also providing a clear line of sight to a presenter or speaker, who is usually positioned at the open end. This setup is ideal for meetings, workshops, or training sessions that require discussion, collaboration, and interaction, as it fosters communication among participants while keeping the presenter visible to everyone.

venue_configuration.name: Boardroom Style
venue_configuration.description: Boardroom style is a seating arrangement where a large, rectangular or oval table is placed in the center of the room, with chairs around it. This setup is commonly used for formal meetings, executive discussions, or strategic planning sessions. The design encourages direct communication and easy collaboration among participants, with all attendees facing each other. It is ideal for smaller, more intimate groups where focused discussions and decision-making take place.

records.name: The Park Hotel
records.description:
About

The Park Hotel is a five-star luxurious hotel venue designed to make your special occasions memorable.

Approach

This hotel venue is nestled in the Parliament Street which is in Hanuman Road Area, Connaught Place, Delhi. It is located at a distance of just 850 m from the Shivaji Stadium Station on the Airport Line of DMRC and 13 km from the Indira Gandhi International Airport.

Ambience

The Park Hotel has grand and extremely posh ambience. Interiors are designed with luxury and are simply splendid! The venue has various spaces such as three fully furnished banquet halls, lush outdoor space, gorgeous poolside area and a finely designed restaurant where a range of events could be hosted. Plush rooms for comfortable guests stay are also available. With an accommodation capacity of up to 250 people, this place is ideal for family gatherings and other medium-sized events!

Food and Service

The venue is efficient in its catering services and has succulent dishes from North Indian, South Indian, Italian, Chinese and Continental cuisine available. For catering purposes, The Park Hotel has dedicated Social Functions and High Tea menu, and they consists of delicacies for both, vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Guest can also savor alcoholic drinks as a full bar is present at the venue. The hotel is highly rated for its hospitality services.

Known For

This venue is suitable for hosting an Anniversary Party, Bachelor Party, Birthday Party, Cocktail Party, Conference, Corporate Party, Exhibition, Engagement, First Birthday Party, Get- together, Kids Party, Meeting, Pool Party, Social Gathering events, all your Pre-wedding functions, Wedding Ceremony and Wedding Reception.

venue_type.name: Hotel + Banquet
venue_type.description: Hotel + banquet venues combine hotel accommodations with dedicated banquet halls for events. They are ideal for weddings, conferences, corporate events, and large celebrations, offering the convenience of stay, catering, and event management in one place. These venues provide a comfortable and well-organized experience with professional services and modern amenities.

event_type.name: Meetings
event_type.description: Meetings are gatherings where people come together to discuss and exchange ideas or information for a specific purpose. They can vary in nature, such as work-related meetings, family discussions, or social gatherings. The main objective of meetings is to make decisions on issues, share information, solve problems, or deliberate on a particular plan.

event_type.name: Birthday Parties
event_type.description: A birthday party is a joyful celebration held to mark an individual's birthday. On this special day, family and friends gather to make the person feel special and celebrate together. Birthday parties typically include activities like cutting a cake, gift exchanges, playing games, and enjoying music. It is an informal and fun event where people spend quality time together, filled with laughter and happiness

event_type.name: Anniversary Celebrations
event_type.description: Celebrate your journey of love with a beautiful anniversary celebration in a cozy and elegant setting. Whether it’s a private moment for the couple or a small gathering with loved ones, the space offers comfort, privacy, and a warm ambiance. Perfect for creating new memories while cherishing the ones you’ve built together.

cuisine_details.name: American Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: American cuisine is diverse and influenced by various cultures, including Native American, European, African, and Asian. It features a wide range of dishes, from classic comfort foods like burgers, fried chicken, and macaroni and cheese to regional specialties such as Southern BBQ, New England clam chowder, and Southwestern tacos. American cuisine often highlights convenience, bold flavors, and an emphasis on grilling and frying.

cuisine_details.name: Bengali Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Bengali cuisine, from the eastern region of India and Bangladesh, is renowned for its rich, flavorful dishes that strike a balance between sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy elements. Rice and fish are central to Bengali meals, with hilsa (a popular fish) often featured in various preparations. Mustard oil, panch phoron (a five-spice mix), and various spices like cumin, turmeric, and ginger play a crucial role in Bengali cooking

cuisine_details.name: Bhojpuri Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Bhojpuri cuisine, from the Bhojpuri-speaking regions of northern India, particularly in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and parts of Nepal, is characterized by its hearty, rustic dishes that focus on locally sourced ingredients. The cuisine is simple yet flavorful, often using mustard oil, ghee, and a variety of spices like cumin, coriander, and turmeric.

cuisine_details.name: Indian Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Indian cuisine is incredibly diverse, reflecting the country’s rich cultural, geographical, and historical diversity. It is known for its bold flavors, vibrant spices, and a variety of ingredients, with a focus on balance between sweet, sour, salty, and spicy elements. Indian meals often feature rice, bread (like roti or naan), lentils, vegetables, and meats such as chicken, lamb, and fish, although vegetarianism is common, particularly in regions like Gujarat and Rajasthan.

cuisine_details.name: Mughlai Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Mughlai cuisine is a rich and flavorful culinary tradition that originated in the royal kitchens of the Mughal Empire, which ruled over much of South Asia from the 16th to the 19th centuries. Known for its use of aromatic spices, rich gravies, and tender meats, Mughlai cuisine combines elements of Persian, Central Asian, and Indian culinary traditions. It features complex flavors, with a balance of spicy, sour, and sweet notes.

cuisine_details.name: Sea Foods Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Seafood cuisine refers to dishes made from fish, shellfish, and other edible marine life, often prepared using fresh ingredients and diverse cooking methods. With a wide variety of flavors and textures, seafood cuisine is popular worldwide and is particularly beloved in coastal regions where fresh seafood is abundant. Seafood dishes vary greatly across cultures and cuisines, from grilled fish to raw sushi, steamed clams, lobster boils, and seafood pastas.

cuisine_details.name: Sindhi Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Sindhi cuisine is the traditional food of the Sindh region, which spans parts of Pakistan and India. Known for its bold and aromatic flavors, Sindhi food incorporates a rich variety of spices, herbs, and ingredients that create a distinctive taste profile. The cuisine has been influenced by the region’s diverse cultural history, combining elements from Persian, Central Asian, Indian, and Mughal culinary traditions.

cuisine_details.name: Singaporean Chinese Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Singaporean Chinese cuisine is a vibrant and diverse culinary tradition that blends traditional Chinese cooking styles with local flavors and ingredients from Singapore’s multicultural heritage. Known for its bold use of spices, fresh ingredients, and a variety of cooking methods, Singaporean Chinese cuisine is influenced by Cantonese, Hokkien, Teochew, and other Chinese regional styles, as well as Malay and Indian culinary traditions. The resulting dishes are unique to Singapore, often featuring seafood, meats, vegetables, and fragrant rice and noodle dishes

cuisine_details.name: Singaporean Indian Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Singaporean Indian cuisine is a rich and diverse culinary tradition that reflects the fusion of Indian spices, cooking techniques, and local influences. Singapore’s Indian community, primarily made up of Tamil, Punjabi, and other regional groups, has played a significant role in shaping the local food scene. The cuisine is characterized by its bold flavors, aromatic spices, and the use of fresh herbs, vegetables, meats, and rice.

cuisine_details.name: South India Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: South Indian cuisine is a rich and diverse culinary tradition that originates from the southern region of India, including states like Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana. Known for its use of aromatic spices, rice-based dishes, lentils, coconut, and a variety of fresh vegetables, South Indian food is distinct for its flavors that balance spicy, tangy, and earthy elements.

cuisine_details.name: Turkish Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Turkish cuisine is a rich and diverse culinary tradition that reflects the country's cultural and historical diversity, blending Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, Central Asian, and Balkan influences. The cuisine is characterized by its use of fresh ingredients, aromatic spices, and bold flavors, as well as its variety of meat dishes, vegetables, bread, and sweets.

cuisine_details.name: North Indian
cuisine_details.description: North Indian cuisine is known for its rich flavors, aromatic spices, and traditional cooking techniques. It features popular dishes like butter chicken, paneer tikka, dal makhani, kebabs, and a variety of breads such as naan and tandoori roti. Perfect for weddings, parties, and banquets, North Indian cuisine offers a hearty and satisfying dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Gujarati
cuisine_details.description: Gujarati cuisine is a flavorful and predominantly vegetarian culinary style known for its unique balance of sweet, spicy, and tangy tastes. It includes popular dishes like dhokla, khandvi, thepla, undhiyu, dal, kadhi, and traditional thali servings. Ideal for weddings and festive events, Gujarati cuisine offers a wholesome and delightful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Fusion
cuisine_details.description: Fusion cuisine is a creative culinary style that blends flavors, ingredients, and cooking techniques from different cultures. It combines traditional recipes with modern twists, offering innovative dishes and unique presentations. Ideal for weddings and premium events, fusion cuisine delivers a diverse, exciting, and memorable dining experience for guests.

cuisine_details.name: Fast Food
cuisine_details.description: Fast food cuisine offers quick, delicious, and crowd-pleasing dishes loved by guests of all ages. It includes popular items like burgers, pizzas, sandwiches, fries, wraps, and fried snacks. Ideal for parties, corporate events, and casual gatherings, fast food counters provide convenient service and a fun, energetic dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Jain Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Jain cuisine is a pure vegetarian culinary tradition prepared without onion, garlic, or root vegetables, following strict Jain dietary principles. It focuses on fresh ingredients, mild spices, and sattvic cooking methods. Ideal for weddings and religious events, Jain cuisine offers a wholesome, pure, and spiritually mindful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Pure Vegetarian
cuisine_details.description: Pure Vegetarian cuisine features a wide variety of dishes prepared entirely without meat, poultry, or seafood. It includes flavorful curries, lentils, fresh vegetables, breads, rice preparations, and delightful desserts. Ideal for weddings, religious events, and social gatherings, pure vegetarian menus offer a wholesome, diverse, and satisfying dining experience for all guests.

cuisine_details.name: Vegan
cuisine_details.description: Vegan cuisine is a plant-based culinary style prepared without any animal products, including dairy, eggs, or honey. It features fresh vegetables, grains, legumes, nuts, and innovative dairy-free alternatives. Ideal for modern weddings and health-conscious events, vegan menus offer a nutritious, sustainable, and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: BBQ & Gril
cuisine_details.description: BBQ & Grill cuisine features smoky, flame-cooked dishes prepared over open grills or charcoal. It includes grilled vegetables, paneer, kebabs, skewers, seafood, and marinated specialties served hot and fresh. Ideal for outdoor events, weddings, and cocktail parties, BBQ and grill counters create an interactive and flavorful dining experience.

cuisine_details.name: Multi-Cuisine
cuisine_details.description: Multi-cuisine offers a diverse selection of dishes from different regional and international culinary traditions in one menu. It includes Indian, Continental, Asian, and other global specialties to suit varied tastes. Ideal for weddings and large events, multi-cuisine catering ensures variety, flexibility, and a satisfying dining experience for all guests.

terms_conditions_details.name: Prices are subject to change without prior notice.
terms_conditions_details.description: All quoted prices are subject to revision based on market conditions, government regulations, or cost fluctuations. While confirmed bookings remain secure, additional services or modifications requested later may be charged at updated rates.

terms_conditions_details.name: Guest count must be informed 7 days prior to event.
terms_conditions_details.description: Final guest count must be communicated at least seven days before the event date. This ensures proper seating, catering preparation, staffing, and overall arrangements. Changes after the deadline may incur additional charges.

terms_conditions_details.name: Minimum guarantee pax required.
terms_conditions_details.description: A minimum guaranteed number of guests (pax) is required as per the agreement. Billing will be based on the guaranteed count, even if actual attendance is lower. This helps the venue plan catering, staffing, and service resources efficiently.

terms_conditions_details.name: Taxes will be charged as applicable.
terms_conditions_details.description: All applicable government taxes and service charges will be added to the final invoice as per prevailing laws. Tax rates are subject to change according to government regulations and will be charged accordingly.

terms_conditions_details.name: Overtime charges applicable beyond agreed hours.
terms_conditions_details.description: Events extending beyond the agreed booking duration will incur additional overtime charges. These charges cover staff, utilities, security, and operational costs. Overtime rates will be applied as per the venue’s standard pricing policy.

terms_conditions_details.name: Date change subject to availability.
terms_conditions_details.description: Requests for changing the event date are subject to venue availability. Approval is not guaranteed and may involve additional charges. Advance payments may be adjusted to the new date as per venue policies.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cancellation before 30 days – partial refund.
terms_conditions_details.description: Cancellations requested more than 30 days prior to the event date are eligible for a partial refund of the total booking amount. This deduction accounts for administrative overhead and the opportunity cost of holding the date. The exact percentage of the refund will be determined based on the specific event package.

terms_conditions_details.name: Cancellation within 15 days – no refund.
terms_conditions_details.description: Any cancellation made within 15 days of the scheduled event is strictly non-refundable. At this stage, resources have been fully committed, staff scheduled, and the venue has lost the ability to rebook the date. This policy ensures the venue is protected against late-stage revenue loss and operational expenses.

terms_conditions_details.name: Security deposit mandatory.
terms_conditions_details.description: A security deposit is a mandatory requirement for all event bookings to cover unforeseen contingencies. This deposit is held separately from the event fee and acts as a financial guarantee. It must be paid in full along with the final balance to ensure the booking remains valid and active.

terms_conditions_details.name: Fire safety rules mandatory.
terms_conditions_details.description: Compliance with all fire safety protocols, including keeping emergency exits clear and adhering to maximum occupancy limits, is mandatory. The use of open flames, lamps, or candles must be pre-approved and placed in secure holders. Any violation of fire safety standards will result in an immediate halt of setup.

terms_conditions_details.name: No hazardous materials allowed.
terms_conditions_details.description: Items classified as hazardous, including explosives, flammable chemicals, pressurized gases, or corrosive substances, are strictly forbidden inside the venue. This policy is in place to prevent accidents and ensure the safety of all occupants. Any vendor bringing specialized equipment must receive prior clearance from the venue manager.

terms_conditions_details.name: Security staff instructions must be followed.
terms_conditions_details.description: For the safety and orderly flow of the event, all guests must comply with the directions provided by the venue’s security personnel. Our staff is authorized to manage crowd control, parking, and access to restricted areas. Failure to cooperate with security may lead to removal from the premises.

terms_conditions_details.name: Any damage caused by guests chargeable.
terms_conditions_details.description: The client is financially responsible for any damage to the venue’s structure, furniture, or equipment caused by the negligence or misconduct of their guests. An assessment of repairs will be conducted post-event, and the costs will be recovered from the security deposit or billed directly to the client.

terms_conditions_details.name: Guests must follow local authority rules.
terms_conditions_details.description: All event attendees are required to adhere to the regulations set forth by the municipal corporation and local police. This includes adherence to parking norms, public smoking bans, and health and safety protocols. Non-compliance with these public orders may lead to penalties being levied against the event host.

terms_conditions_details.name: Loud music beyond permitted hours not allowed.
terms_conditions_details.description: To comply with local noise pollution regulations and community guidelines, all amplified music must cease by the legally mandated time. The venue reserves the right to disconnect power to sound systems if volume limits or timing restrictions are ignored. It is the client's responsibility to manage their DJ’s performance.

terms_conditions_details.name: Illegal activities strictly prohibited.
terms_conditions_details.description: The premises must be used exclusively for lawful purposes. Any form of gambling, substance abuse, or other activities prohibited by law will result in immediate event termination and notification to the authorities. The client assumes full legal responsibility for any unlawful conduct occurring during their booked time slot.

terms_conditions_details.name: Venue not responsible for personal belongings.
terms_conditions_details.description: The venue management and staff are not liable for the loss, theft, or damage of any personal items, jewelry, or electronics brought onto the premises by guests or vendors. We strongly recommend that clients arrange for their own security or storage for valuables, as the venue does not provide locker facilities.

terms_conditions_details.name: Smoking only in designated areas.
terms_conditions_details.description: To maintain a smoke-free environment and ensure the comfort of all attendees, smoking is strictly prohibited inside the main halls, dining areas, and restrooms. Guests wishing to smoke must use the specifically marked outdoor zones. This policy helps prevent fire hazards and ensures compliance with public health and safety regulations.

package_details.description: The Team Engagement Package is ideal for fostering team spirit and celebrating achievements within your organization. It is perfect for team outings, celebrations, and internal gatherings where interaction and bonding are key. The package is designed to provide a stress-free experience with smooth service and a welcoming ambiance, allowing your team to connect, relax, and celebrate together.

package_details.name: Business Lunch Package
package_details.description: The Business Lunch Package is tailored for formal meetings and small corporate gatherings where time and efficiency matter. With a selection of fresh soups, wholesome main courses, and delightful desserts, this package provides a complete dining experience. Ideal for client meetings, team discussions, and networking lunches, it creates a comfortable environment for meaningful conversations. The focus is on quick service, quality food, and a professional setup, making it a perfect choice for busy business schedules.

package_details.name: Grand Banquet Celebration Package

venue_configuration.name: Cluster Style
venue_configuration.description: Cluster style is a seating arrangement typically used in meeting or event spaces, where chairs or tables are grouped together in small clusters or circles. This setup encourages interaction, collaboration, and discussion among participants, making it ideal for brainstorming sessions, team meetings, or group activities. It offers a more informal and flexible alternative to traditional rows of seating.

venue_configuration.name: Banquet Hall
venue_configuration.description: A banquet hall is a large, spacious venue typically used for hosting events such as weddings, parties, conferences, or formal gatherings. It is designed to accommodate a significant number of guests and is often equipped with tables, chairs, and catering facilities. Banquet halls offer a versatile setting for various social and professional events.

venue_configuration.name: Banquet Style
venue_configuration.description: Banquet style is a seating arrangement where round tables are placed throughout the room, typically with guests seated around them. This setup is commonly used for events such as weddings, formal dinners, or award ceremonies. Banquet style encourages social interaction among guests while providing space for dining. The tables are often set with linens, chairs, and sometimes a centerpiece, creating a more relaxed and communal atmosphere for dining and conversation.

venue_configuration.name: Cabaret Style
venue_configuration.description: Cabaret style is a seating arrangement where round tables are placed around a central stage or presentation area, with chairs arranged at an angle, so guests have a clear view of the stage. This setup is typically used for events like dinner shows, performances, or conferences with a social aspect. The layout allows for smaller groups to interact while also focusing on the main presentation or entertainment. It’s ideal for events that combine dining with entertainment or speeches.
